title: Northloop Guarantee Terms for Marketplace Orders
content:
**Terms.** A Northloop Guarantee claim on a Marketplace Orders order is filed no later than the claim window counted in calendar days from the order's promised delivery date, and no more than the option's claims-per-order limit may be filed on one order. An item-not-received claim may be filed only once the item-not-received wait days after the promised delivery date have passed without a delivered scan. A not-as-described, damaged-item or return-not-refunded claim requires a return request on the order; return-not-refunded additionally requires that the refund deadline after the received-at-destination scan has passed without an item refund. Where the seller is the liability party the seller has the response business days to refund before the claim is decided. An item-not-received claim on a seller-shipped order with invalid tracking is granted against the seller when the option's invalid-tracking automatic grant setting is true; one with a valid delivered scan is denied unless the order total is at or above the signature threshold and no signature was confirmed. A granted claim and a return refund cannot both pay the same units. Either party may appeal once within the appeal window after the decision.

**Retired clause.** The former clause "The granted amount is the order's net paid amount at decision time, capped at the claim cap, and is funded by the option's liability party." is no longer in force; it has been superseded by the current basis for the granted amount.

## Filing window, read from the order record

The clock starts from the order's promised delivery date as recorded on the order. The claim is in time on any day up to and including the promised delivery date plus the claim window in calendar days. The number of claims already filed on the order over its lifetime is compared with the claims-per-order limit.

### Hypothetical boundary

With a hypothetical promised delivery date of 1 March and a 90-day window, a claim filed on 30 May is in time and one filed on 31 May is late.

## Claim reasons and what each requires

| Claim reason | Requirement |
|---|---|
| item not received | the item-not-received wait days after the promised delivery date have passed without a delivered scan |
| not as described | a return request on the order |
| damaged item | a return request on the order |
| return not refunded | a return request on the order, and the refund deadline after the received-at-destination scan has passed without an item refund |

## Seller-shipped item-not-received claims

| Tracking and delivery evidence | Outcome |
|---|---|
| invalid tracking, invalid-tracking automatic grant true | granted against the seller |
| valid delivered scan, order total below the signature threshold | denied |
| valid delivered scan, order total at or above the threshold, signature confirmed | denied |
| valid delivered scan, order total at or above the threshold, no signature confirmed | not denied on this ground |

superseded_clauses: The granted amount is the order's net_paid_amount at decision time, capped at the claim cap, and is funded by the option's liability party.
